# ---- Chi phi (ty USD) vao bien tam VIE_naval_cost: so tau x gia/tau x he so noi dia hoa (1,0 / 1,15 / 1,3) ----
VIE_p1b_cost = {
	set_temp_variable = { VIE_naval_cost = VIE_p1b_qty }
	multiply_temp_variable = { VIE_naval_cost = VIE_p1b_unit }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_loc = 1 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { VIE_naval_cost = 1.15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_loc = 2 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { VIE_naval_cost = 1.3 }
	}
	# P1 (ho ve han nhe) hybrid/noi dia la tau chien dau co nho: he so Decision 3 cua Truc 2 (0,8-0,9) ap dung
	# nhu voi Molniya pha 2 cua Truc 1. Nhap khau khong duoc giam.
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { VIE_p1b_cur = 1 }
			check_variable = { VIE_p1b_loc > 0 }
			check_variable = { VIE_small_combatant_cost_mult > 0 }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { VIE_naval_cost = VIE_small_combatant_cost_mult }
	}
}

# ---- Funding Gate (A5): dung VIE_naval_can_fund cua Truc 1. Truot -> event .3 ----
VIE_p1b_funding_check = {
	VIE_p1b_cost = yes
	if = {
		limit = { VIE_naval_can_fund = yes }
		VIE_p1b_contract = yes
	}
	else = {
		country_event = { id = vie_p1b.3 }
	}
}

# ---- Tra tien: ngan kho hoac vay (no = chi phi x 1,1 neu co VIE_p1b_use_debt) ----
VIE_p1b_pay = {
	VIE_p1b_cost = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = VIE_p1b_use_debt }
		set_temp_variable = { debt_change = VIE_naval_cost }
		multiply_temp_variable = { debt_change = 1.1 }
		modify_debt_effect = yes
		hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = VIE_p1b_use_debt }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = VIE_naval_cost }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
}

VIE_p1b_load_corvette = {
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_cur = 1 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_unit = 0.4 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_q1 = 2 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_q2 = 4 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_q3 = 6 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_qty = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_loc = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_import = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_hybrid = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_domestic = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					country_exists = HOL
					NOT = { has_war_with = HOL }
				}
				AND = {
					country_exists = SOV
					NOT = { has_war_with = SOV }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_import = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { VIE_var_small_combatant_tier > 0 }
			check_variable = { VIE_var_ba_son_tier > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_hybrid = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { VIE_var_small_combatant_tier > 1 }
			check_variable = { VIE_var_ba_son_tier > 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_domestic = 1 }
	}
}

		set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_domestic = 1 }
	}
}

		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_asw_frigate_qty_delivered = 1 } }
		create_ship = { type = frigate_hull_4 equipment_variant = "VIE ASW Frigate Class" creator = VIE name = "Khinh hạm chống ngầm 2" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_asw_frigate_qty_delivered = 2 } }
		create_ship = { type = frigate_hull_4 equipment_variant = "VIE ASW Frigate Class" creator = VIE name = "Khinh hạm chống ngầm 3" }
	}
	else = {
		create_ship = { type = frigate_hull_4 equipment_variant = "VIE ASW Frigate Class" creator = VIE name = "Khinh hạm chống ngầm 4" }
	}
	add_to_variable = { VIE_p1b_asw_frigate_qty_delivered = 1 }
	add_to_variable = { VIE_var_hulls_delivered = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_asw_frigate_localization = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_nav_exp_gain = 3 }
		VIE_nav_add_shipbuilding_exp = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_asw_frigate_localization = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_nav_exp_gain = 1.5 }
		VIE_nav_add_shipbuilding_exp = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_asw_frigate_localization = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_nav_exp_gain = 2 }
		VIE_nav_add_integration_exp = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_asw_frigate_localization = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_nav_exp_gain = 1 }
		VIE_nav_add_integration_exp = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_asw_frigate_qty_delivered < VIE_p1b_asw_frigate_qty_ordered } }
		country_event = { id = vie_p1b.13 days = 240 }
	}
	else = {
		VIE_p1b_program_end = yes
	}
}

########################################################################
# P4 Tau ngam tan cong khu vuc (ssk_reg)
########################################################################
VIE_p1b_load_ssk_reg = {
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_cur = 4 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_unit = 0.55 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_q1 = 2 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_q2 = 3 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_q3 = 4 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_qty = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_loc = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_import = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_hybrid = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_domestic = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					country_exists = SOV
					NOT = { has_war_with = SOV }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_import = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { VIE_var_ba_son_tier > 2 }
			check_variable = { VIE_var_integration_tier > 1 }
			VIE_naval_has_sub_mro = yes
		}
		set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_hybrid = 1 }
	}
}

VIE_p1b_ensure_variant_ssk_reg = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = VIE_p1b_variant_ssk_reg_done } }
		hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = VIE_p1b_variant_ssk_reg_done }
		create_equipment_variant = {
			name = "VIE Regional SSK Class"
			type = attack_submarine_hull_4
			allow_without_tech = yes
			parent_version = 0
			role_icon_index = 14
			modules = {
				fixed_ship_engine_slot = module_sub_diesel_electric_power3
				fixed_ship_radar_slot = module_sonar_5
				fixed_ship_auxillary_slot_3 = module_torpedoes_3
				fixed_ship_auxillary_slot_2 = module_sub_esm_2
				fixed_ship_auxillary_slot_1 = module_minelaying
				fixed_ship_auxillary_slot = module_torpedoes_3
				fixed_ship_battery_slot = module_anti_ship_torpedoes_3
			}
		}
	}
}

VIE_p1b_contract_ssk_reg = {
	hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = VIE_p1b_ssk_reg_contracted }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssk_reg_qty_ordered = VIE_p1b_qty }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssk_reg_qty_delivered = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssk_reg_localization = VIE_p1b_loc }
	VIE_p1b_pay = yes
	set_technology = { attack_submarine_hull_4 = 1 }
	VIE_p1b_ensure_variant_ssk_reg = yes
	VIE_p1b_program_start = yes
	set_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_days = 1620 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_loc = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_days = 1944 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_loc = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_days = 2268 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_total = VIE_p1b_qty }
	add_to_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_total = -1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_total = 240 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_total = VIE_p1b_days }
	add_timed_idea = { idea = VIE_p1b_prog_ssk_reg days = VIE_p1b_total }
	country_event = { id = vie_p1b.14 days = VIE_p1b_days }
}

VIE_p1b_deliver_ssk_reg = {
	VIE_p1b_ensure_variant_ssk_reg = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssk_reg_qty_delivered = 0 } }
		create_ship = { type = attack_submarine_hull_4 equipment_variant = "VIE Regional SSK Class" creator = VIE name = "Tàu ngầm khu vực 1" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssk_reg_qty_delivered = 1 } }
		create_ship = { type = attack_submarine_hull_4 equipment_variant = "VIE Regional SSK Class" creator = VIE name = "Tàu ngầm khu vực 2" }
	}
	else_if = {

		create_ship = { type = attack_submarine_hull_4 equipment_variant = "VIE Regional SSK Class" creator = VIE name = "Tàu ngầm khu vực 3" }
	}
	else = {
		create_ship = { type = attack_submarine_hull_4 equipment_variant = "VIE Regional SSK Class" creator = VIE name = "Tàu ngầm khu vực 4" }

		VIE_nav_add_shipbuilding_exp = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssk_reg_localization = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_nav_exp_gain = 2 }
		VIE_nav_add_shipbuilding_exp = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssk_reg_localization = 2 } }

	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_destroyer_localization = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_nav_exp_gain = 1.5 }
		VIE_nav_add_integration_exp = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_destroyer_qty_delivered < VIE_p1b_destroyer_qty_ordered } }
		country_event = { id = vie_p1b.18 days = 240 }
	}
	else = {
		VIE_p1b_program_end = yes
	}
}

########################################################################
# P10 Tau san bay hang nhe (carrier)
########################################################################
VIE_p1b_load_carrier = {
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_cur = 10 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_unit = 2.7 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_q1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_q2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_q3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_qty = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_loc = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_import = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_hybrid = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_domestic = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					country_exists = RAJ
					NOT = { has_war_with = RAJ }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_import = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = VIE_cap_mature_naval_industry
		}
		set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_hybrid = 1 }
	}
}

VIE_p1b_ensure_variant_carrier = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = VIE_p1b_variant_carrier_done } }
		hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = VIE_p1b_variant_carrier_done }
		create_equipment_variant = {
			name = "VIE Light Carrier Class"
			type = carrier_hull_3
			allow_without_tech = yes
			parent_version = 0
			role_icon_index = 2
			modules = {
				fixed_ship_engine_slot = module_surface_diesel_power_3
				fixed_ship_fire_control_system_slot = module_advanced_integrated_missile_radar_control
				fixed_ship_radar_slot = module_radar_4
				fixed_ship_auxillary_slot_2 = module_ciws_3
				fixed_ship_auxillary_slot_1 = module_ram_3
				fixed_ship_auxillary_slot = module_esm_1
				fixed_ship_flight_deck = module_flight_deck_4
				front_1_custom_slot = module_ram_3
				front_2_custom_slot = module_ciws_3
				mid_1_custom_slot = module_helipads_3
				rear_1_custom_slot = module_naval_adl_3
				rear_2_custom_slot = module_ciws_3
			}
		}
	}
}

VIE_p1b_contract_carrier = {
	hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = VIE_p1b_carrier_contracted }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_carrier_qty_ordered = VIE_p1b_qty }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_carrier_qty_delivered = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_carrier_localization = VIE_p1b_loc }
	VIE_p1b_pay = yes
	set_technology = { carrier_hull_3 = 1 }
	VIE_p1b_ensure_variant_carrier = yes
	VIE_p1b_program_start = yes
	set_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_days = 2520 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_loc = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_days = 3024 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_loc = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_days = 3528 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_total = VIE_p1b_qty }
	add_to_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_total = -1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_total = 240 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_total = VIE_p1b_days }
	add_timed_idea = { idea = VIE_p1b_prog_carrier days = VIE_p1b_total }
	country_event = { id = vie_p1b.20 days = VIE_p1b_days }
}

VIE_p1b_deliver_carrier = {
	VIE_p1b_ensure_variant_carrier = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_carrier_qty_delivered = 0 } }
		create_ship = { type = carrier_hull_3 equipment_variant = "VIE Light Carrier Class" creator = VIE name = "Tàu sân bay hạng nhẹ" }
	}
	add_to_variable = { VIE_p1b_carrier_qty_delivered = 1 }
	add_to_variable = { VIE_var_hulls_delivered = 1 }
	add_to_variable = { VIE_var_hulls_carrier = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_carrier_localization = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_nav_exp_gain = 6 }
		VIE_nav_add_shipbuilding_exp = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_carrier_localization = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_nav_exp_gain = 3 }
		VIE_nav_add_shipbuilding_exp = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_carrier_localization = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_nav_exp_gain = 4 }
		VIE_nav_add_integration_exp = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_carrier_localization = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_nav_exp_gain = 2 }
		VIE_nav_add_integration_exp = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_carrier_qty_delivered < VIE_p1b_carrier_qty_ordered } }
		country_event = { id = vie_p1b.20 days = 240 }
	}
	else = {
		VIE_p1b_program_end = yes
	}
}

	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_loc = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_import = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_hybrid = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_domestic = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					country_exists = SOV
					NOT = { has_war_with = SOV }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ok_import = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = VIE_cap_mature_naval_industry
		}

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = VIE_p1b_variant_ssn_done } }
		hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = VIE_p1b_variant_ssn_done }
		create_equipment_variant = {
			name = "VIE SSN Class"
			type = attack_submarine_hull_5
			allow_without_tech = yes

				fixed_ship_auxillary_slot_2 = module_sub_esm_2
				fixed_ship_auxillary_slot_1 = module_minelaying
				fixed_ship_auxillary_slot = module_torpedoes_3
				fixed_ship_battery_slot = module_anti_ship_torpedoes_3
			}
		}
	}
}

VIE_p1b_contract_ssn = {
	hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = VIE_p1b_ssn_contracted }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssn_qty_ordered = VIE_p1b_qty }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssn_qty_delivered = 0 }
	set_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssn_localization = VIE_p1b_loc }
	VIE_p1b_pay = yes
	set_technology = { attack_submarine_hull_5 = 1 tech_nuclear_power_systems_1 = 1 }
	VIE_p1b_ensure_variant_ssn = yes
	VIE_p1b_program_start = yes
	set_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_days = 2880 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_loc = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_days = 3456 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_loc = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_days = 4032 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_total = VIE_p1b_qty }
	add_to_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_total = -1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_total = 240 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { VIE_p1b_total = VIE_p1b_days }
	add_timed_idea = { idea = VIE_p1b_prog_ssn days = VIE_p1b_total }
	country_event = { id = vie_p1b.21 days = VIE_p1b_days }
}

VIE_p1b_deliver_ssn = {
	VIE_p1b_ensure_variant_ssn = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssn_qty_delivered = 0 } }
		create_ship = { type = attack_submarine_hull_5 equipment_variant = "VIE SSN Class" creator = VIE name = "Tàu ngầm hạt nhân 1" }
	}
	else = {
		create_ship = { type = attack_submarine_hull_5 equipment_variant = "VIE SSN Class" creator = VIE name = "Tàu ngầm hạt nhân 2" }
	}
	add_to_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssn_qty_delivered = 1 }
	add_to_variable = { VIE_var_hulls_delivered = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssn_localization = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_nav_exp_gain = 6 }
		VIE_nav_add_shipbuilding_exp = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssn_localization = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_nav_exp_gain = 3 }
		VIE_nav_add_shipbuilding_exp = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssn_localization = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_nav_exp_gain = 6 }
		VIE_nav_add_integration_exp = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssn_localization = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { VIE_nav_exp_gain = 3 }
		VIE_nav_add_integration_exp = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { VIE_p1b_ssn_qty_delivered < VIE_p1b_ssn_qty_ordered } }
		country_event = { id = vie_p1b.21 days = 240 }
	}
	else = {
		VIE_p1b_program_end = yes
	}
}
